description:
This is to advise you that solicitation number PR15862528 issued on February 24, 2026, for the Supply and installation of a LoraWan Antenna Mast services, has been canceled.

The cancellatiopn has been made following carefull consideration by the U.S. Embassy, which has determined that the services are no longer required within the organization.Consequently, the Embassy will not proceed with the awarding of this contract.

Your name will be maintained on our mailing list, and you will receive a notification if the new solicitation has been issued on www.sam.gov. You may contact HarareGSOProcurement@state.gov  if you have any questions.
